name: Hunan Valin Wire & Cable Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hunan Valin Wire & Cable Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of wires and cables in China. The company offers special cables, including data communication, robot, rail transit, mining, new energy special weather-resistant special soft, high flame retardant and fire-resistant, and special engineering equipment cables; aerospace and integrated equipment; and power cables, cables for electrical equipment, and bare conductors and wires. Its products are used in aerospace, smart mine, iron and steel smelting, high-end equipment, rail transit, green energy, smart grid, offshore oil, petrochemical, and building and home decoration industries.
